caption: A car drives along a road, passes behind a parked truck, and reappears on the far side of it.

sa.check: A car drives along a road.
It passes behind a parked truck.
It reappears on the far side of the truck.
The disappearance comes first and the reappearance follows.

pc.expect: It is the same car, and it does not show through the truck.
pc.fail: A different car emerges; or two cars; or the car appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: It is hidden for a time consistent with its speed and the truck's length and emerges at the same speed and heading.
pc.fail: It emerges instantly; or after far too long; or emerges going back.

pc.expect: The car is not visible through the truck.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the truck; or the truck passes through the car.
The truck moves; or vanishes; or the road changes.

pc.expect: One car and one truck keep their shape.
pc.fail: The car turns into another vehicle; or the truck changes shape; or the car merges with the truck.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the truck changes colour; or the street rearranges.
